project: Ensemble Learning for Sri Lankan Food Price Analysis and Forecasting

dataset.title: Sri Lanka - Food Prices
dataset.licence: Humanitarian Data Exchange entry for WFP food prices is published under the Creative Commons Attribution for Intergovernmental Organisations (CC BY-IGO) licence. Confirm the current licence text on the HDX resource page before redistribution.
dataset.attribution: Source: World Food Programme (WFP), via the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX).
dataset.notes: Monthly retail and wholesale food prices by market and commodity, in Sri Lankan Rupees (LKR), with a USD price column supplied by WFP.

split.note: Test series not present in training are predicted from their own lag features; the categorical encoder maps any unseen category to -1.

model_table.reason: A row needs at least three consecutive prior monthly observations in its own series before lag_1..lag_3 and the 3-month rolling statistics exist.

preprocessing.outlier_rule: |robust z| > 6.0, where robust z uses the per-series median and median absolute deviation
preprocessing.outlier_policy: Flagged only. Extreme food prices in 2022-2023 reflect Sri Lanka's real inflation episode, so removing them would delete genuine signal.

preprocessing.gap_policy: Gaps are left as gaps. Lags are computed over the observed ordering within each series, and the pipeline records that a lag may therefore span more than one calendar month for series with missing months.

stacking.leakage_control: Meta-learner trained only on TimeSeriesSplit out-of-fold predictions; 3688 earliest training rows had no OOF prediction and were excluded from meta-training.
